pages.title: Planets
pages.text: Northstar models many bodies, but only four have a surface to land on: the Moon, Mars, Mercury and Venus. Each has a surface and an orbit dimension. The rest are sky scenery in the atlas.

pages.title: The numbers
pages.text:
Gravity, temperature, air:
- Moon 1.6, -183 C, none
- Mars 3.71, -100 C, thin
- Mercury 3.7, -200 to 434 C, none
- Venus 8.87, 464 C, dense\
Orbits: no gravity, -270 C

pages.title: The Moon
pages.text: Lunar Plains, hills, crater fields and caves of ice, glowstone and asurine. Ores: titanium, zinc, copper, iron, gold, diamond, redstone, lapis, glowstone. Mobs: Moon Eel, Lunargrade, Snail. Abandoned lunar bases can be explored.

pages.title: Moon Titanium Ore
pages.text: Smelt it directly into a Titanium Ingot. Titanium ore appears on all four worlds.

pages.title: Mars
pages.text: Martian dunes, highlands, peaks and caverns with crimsite and overgrown plants. Ores: titanium, iron, copper, zinc, gold, diamond, quartz, redstone. Mobs: Cobra, Devil Moth, Root Toad, Echo Worm. Martian iron and ash make Martian steel.

pages.title: Mars Titanium Ore
pages.text: Mars also has palms, tulips and Martian strawberry bushes.

pages.title: Mercury
pages.text: Hills, basins, and icy or magmatic caverns, with a huge swing between day and night. Only world with tungsten ore. Also titanium, glowstone, lapis, gold, diamond. Mobs: Mercurian Raptor, Roach, Tortoise.

pages.title: Mercury Tungsten Ore
pages.text: The only source of tungsten. Crushed raw tungsten is washed into nuggets.

pages.title: Venus
pages.text: Fungal forests, lava and sulfuric caverns under a very dense atmosphere. Ores: coal, quartz, glowstone, titanium and others. Mobs: Mimic, Scorpion, Stone Bull, Vulture. Sulfuric Acid kills if you swim in it.

pages.title: Venus Gravel
pages.text: Crushing it gives the most Rutile Concentrate of any source, for making titanium on Earth.
